subject: Re: Hosted API pricing for Harbor Health - request for senior approval
messages:
From: Devin Shah <devin@harborhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Alicia Monroe <procurement@harborhealth.com>
Date: 2027-05-23T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Hosted API pricing for pilot and 1yr commit

Marissa —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Harbor Health is excited by Redwood's latency and cost profile; the product checks a lot of boxes for our clinician-facing summarization use case. Based on internal forecasts attached, our pilot will consume ~75M tokens/month and we expect production to ramp to ~300M tokens/month within 6 months.

Real ask: to make this viable inside our budget we need a meaningful usage discount on Hosted API list rates. Specifically, we need something north of 20% off list for an initial 12-month committed program (we can commit to a minimum $1.2M TCV in year 1).

We also have the usual security and procurement items attached (SOC2 excerpts and an SOW template). Can you please confirm if Redwood can offer a concession at that level and what the conditions would be?

Devin
Head of Integrations
Harbor Health

Attachments: Harbor_Usage_Projection.xlsx, Harbor_SOC2_Response.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Devin Shah <devin@harborhealth.com>, Alicia Monroe <procurement@harborhealth.com>
Date: 2027-05-23T13:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing for pilot and 1yr commit

Looping in Ben and Karthik — this is a high-velocity strategic opportunity. Harbor's projected volumes would make them a meaningful enterprise customer if we can secure the technical references and legal terms.

Quick background: Harbor is offering a 12-month, $1.2M committed usage minimum for year 1 with a clear ramp to multi-region production if pilot goes well. Their ask: >20% off Hosted API list. They are able to sign a standard SOW plus an addendum for usage commitment.

Ask for deal desk: I need a senior pricing clear for a 25% one-time discount to list (applied to token unit pricing) with the following conditions:
- 12-month minimum commitment ($1.2M)
- Quarterly usage review and ability to revert to standard pricing with 60 days notice if usage falls below minimums
- No deviations to data residency or SOC2 requirements beyond what our standard Private offering requires (they accept Hosted controls)

Ben — can you put together the quick economics (net ARR, margin at 25% off, CAC assumptions) and a short recommended motion? Karthik — please flag any operational or precedent concerns.

Marissa
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

>

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Devin Shah <devin@harborhealth.com>
Date: 2027-05-24T09:20:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Hosted API pricing for pilot and 1yr commit — recommended concession

Mina — forwarding Harbor Health request and Marissa's ask. Short economics and recommended structure below. HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/67890

Summary:
- Year 1 committed TCV: $1.2M (per customer forecast attached)
- Ramp -> ~300M tokens/mo by month 6 (pilot at 75M tokens/mo)
- Revenue impact: 25% discount off list reduces gross margin by ~9 p.p. on Hosted API (after infra and support).
- Strategic upside: strong healthcare reference, potential multi-region expansion, marketplace partnership down the line.

Recommended concession (one-off approved discount):
- 25% off list token rates for the first 12 months only (billing per actual usage up to committed minimum; overage at the discounted rate).
- Require a signed SOW and prepayment of 50% of year-1 committed dollars OR monthly auto-billing with a 60-day revert clause if payment issues arise.
- Add clause: usage floors and quarterly cadence to review and adjust if ramp lags more than 40%.

Attachments: Draft_SOW_Harbor_v1.docx (candidate SOW), Harbor_Usage_Projection.xlsx

I recommend approving 25% conditioned on Finance & Legal signoff and a prepay or auto-billing commitment. If we want to be more conservative, approve 20% now and leave room to grant additional credit after pilot success.

Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Devin Shah <devin@harborhealth.com>, Alicia Monroe <procurement@harborhealth.com>
Date: 2027-05-24T15:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Hosted API pricing for pilot and 1yr commit — recommended concession

Thanks for the clear summary. I approve a 25% concession to Hosted API list rates for the first 12 months under the conditions Ben outlined, with two additions:

1) Legal to include a minimum revenue guarantee clause and early-exit remediation (60-day notice, pro-rated true-up).
2) Cap the maximum pre-discount credit we take in year 1 to $350k cumulative to limit exposure on early churns; anything beyond that needs CFO sign-off.

Please get Legal and Finance to prepare the SOW addendum and send the DocuSign link back to me for a final signature. Marissa, Ben — execute the prepay or auto-billing option as discussed; if Harbor cannot prepay, we move to monthly auto-billing with the revert clause.

Mina Haddad
VP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

On 2027-05-24 09:20, Ben Carter wrote:
> Mina — forwarding Harbor Health request ...
>
> Recommended concession: 25% off list token rates for the first 12 months only...

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Devin Shah <devin@harborhealth.com>, Alicia Monroe <procurement@harborhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-25T15:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing for pilot and 1yr commit — approval and next steps

Devin / Alicia — good news: Redwood leadership has approved a 25% concession on Hosted API list pricing for the first 12 months, conditioned on:

- Execution of the SOW and signed addendum (attached draft sent previously).
- A $1.2M committed usage minimum for year 1 with either 50% prepayment or monthly auto-billing plus a 60-day revert clause for non-payment or failure to meet minimum ramp.
- A cap on Redwood's exposure in year 1: pre-discount credit capped at $350k unless escalated to CFO.
- Quarterly business reviews to track ramp; tech success criteria to enable multi-region expansion.

Ben/Karthik — please share the DocuSign link for the SOW with Alicia and confirm billing terms once Legal & Finance have populated the addendum.

Devin — once we receive a countersigned SOW and the initial payment (or billing setup), we will provision the production keys and prioritize onboarding. Looking forward to getting this live.

Best

Marissa Cole
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: Draft_SOW_Harbor_v1.docx, Harbor_Usage_Projection.xlsx, Harbor_SOC2_Response.pdf
